verdict.rationale: The GitHub README states that Weaviate combines vector search, keyword filtering, RAG and reranking in a single query interface, so reranking is claimed as a built-in query capability. Beyond that one line, the pack documents only general model-provider integrations and hybrid score fusion (relativeScoreFusion/rankedFusion), which merges scores rather than applying reranking models. Missing for 10: documentation of specific reranker modules or providers, how to configure reranking in a query, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
